content:
Resolve Breaker is a unique Auto Grenade Launcher that fires cryo grenades rather than the standard high explosive, it also comes with a unique Enclave themed paint.

It is dropped/crafted with the following legendary mods:

Bloodied: Damage Increases up to +95% as Health Decreases

Inertial: Replenish 15 Action Points with Each Kill

Steadfast: +50 DMG Resistance While Aiming

Electritian's: When Reloading, Emit a Shock Wave That Stuns Nearby Targets for 3s

It also has the following custom effects:

Fires 2 Projectiles per Shot

-10 Durability

Target takes 100 Action Points Damage for 10 seconds

Target Movement Speed Reduced by 35% for 10 seconds
